university.name: University of Central Lancashire
university.summary: The University of Central Lancashire has a campus in Preston, in the North West of England, which its international page describes as home to over 27,000 students and staff. Its Pakistan page states that applications from Pakistan must be submitted through a recognised agent.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence
courses.overview: A one-year, in-person master's delivered by the School of Engineering and Computing for graduates of STEM subjects with a substantial computing element.
courses.academic_requirements: At least a 2:2 degree in STEM areas which has a substantive computing element including programming.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 with no components lower than 5.5.
courses.experience_requirements: Substantial relevant industrial experience can be offered in place of the degree requirement; an interview may be required.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page gives no percentages or CGPA. It states the university requires all applications from Pakistan to be submitted through a recognised agent listed on that page.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists machine learning, AI engineering, robotics development, AI ethics and computer vision.
courses.notes: Page shows September 2026 as the only intake, which has already passed, so no intake is recorded; a September 2027 start is not shown. Fee shown is the 2026/27 international fee (2025/26 was 17,900); target year fee not yet published. Module names are not shown on the page.

courses.title: Business and Management
courses.duration_text: 3 years, in person; a foundation year is available
courses.overview: A three-year, in-person business degree with an available foundation year option, leading to roles in management, consulting and enterprise.
courses.academic_requirements: 104 to 112 points at A2; BTEC Extended Diploma DMM; International Baccalaureate Diploma pass including 104 to 112 points from Higher Level subjects; GCSEs: 5 at grade C/4 including Maths and English or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 with no subscore lower than 5.5.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page gives no percentages or CGPA, and names Undergraduate or Master Foundation Programmes offered at the university by ONCampus as an alternative route. It states the university requires all applications from Pakistan to be submitted through a recognised agent listed on that page.
courses.career_notes: The course page describes preparation for leading, innovating, consulting and entrepreneurship; no job titles are listed.
courses.notes: Page shows September 2026 only, which has already passed, so no intake is recorded. Fee is the 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published. Module list and campus are not shown on the page.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
courses.overview: A three-year, in-person undergraduate degree in artificial intelligence and data science.
courses.academic_requirements: 96 to 112 points at A2; BTEC Extended Diploma MMM to DMM; International Baccalaureate Diploma pass including 96 to 112 points from Higher Level subjects; GCSEs: 5 at grade C/4 including Maths and English or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 with no component lower than 5.5.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page gives no percentages or CGPA, and names Undergraduate or Master Foundation Programmes offered at the university by ONCampus as an alternative route. It states the university requires all applications from Pakistan to be submitted through a recognised agent listed on that page.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists machine learning engineer, data analyst and business intelligence analyst.
courses.notes: Page shows September 2026 only, which has already passed, so no intake is recorded. Fee is the 2026/27 international fee (2025/26 was 17,325); target year fee not yet published. Module list is not shown on the page.

scholarships.name: Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,500 for the first year; later years depend on achieving an APM of over 60% (2026/27 entry)
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition fee reduction for undergraduate and postgraduate taught applicants from listed countries, including Pakistan, who meet the enhanced country specific entry criteria for their course.
scholarships.criteria_text: Applicant from a listed country (Pakistan is listed) who meets the enhanced academic country specific entry criteria for their programme. Can be combined with other awards up to GBP 5,500 per year.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; no separate application is needed.
scholarships.notes: The eligible country list is long and includes Pakistan; eligible_countries is limited to PK for this record. The page does not explain the enhanced academic country specific entry criteria and gives no grade thresholds. The page does not state that an offer is required; requires_offer is inferred from the award being applied to a tuition fee, so treat as unconfirmed.
